title: NRL's 1952 appraisal of Brown's device missing

tellings.quote: When Tom Valone of the Integrity Research Institute tried to locate a copy of an appraisal of Brown's experiments conducted in 1952 by the Naval Research Laboratory, the laboratory no longer had it. The paper was called the TT Brown electrogravity device.

plain: A 1952 assessment of the experiments of Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor who worked on devices meant to fly by electrical forces, has gone missing from the Naval Research Laboratory, the US Navy's science lab, which did the study. Michels says that Tom Valone of the Integrity Research Institute went looking for the paper, titled "TT Brown electrogravity device", and was told the lab no longer had it. He tells it as a sign that Navy interest in Brown's work was hidden away.
